description: This file defines the LoginActivity class for an Android TV application, implementing a TV-friendly login screen with focus handling, validation, and navigation logic.

classes.name: LoginActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity providing a TV-optimized login interface with focus handling, validation, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, focus handling, and event listeners.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates username and password inputs, returning error messages or null if valid.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles login submission, validation, user feedback, and navigation to MainActivity.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to start LoginActivity.
